Context: 2026 oil shock (Iran conflict) spiked Indian polymer prices — IOCL PP raffia basic went 94,521 (24 Jan) → 153,021 (1 Apr) → 144,021 INR/t (16 Apr). Prices rose again Sep–Oct 2026 (several +1,000 to +5,000 INR/t revisions). The rupee is ~96.7/USD.
Many current-book rows are COMPOUNDS or FORMS (e.g. 'EPDM 70 Shore A', 'Epoxy infusion system', 'E-glass woven fabric'), whose price is not the raw-polymer anchor; compare with care.

Current book vs evidence (ex-GST INR/kg): PP homo 108.3 vs 128–131 (index, Credco) and 144 basic (IOCL Apr) → LOW ~18–25%; PP copo 125.8 likely low on the same evidence; HDPE 114.86 vs 135.5–137.5 → LOW ~16–20%; uPVC 83.14 vs 96.5–108 (and import 97.5–102.75) → LOW ~16–30%; PET bottle 132.36 vs ~104.5 (index) / 90–100 (aggregator) → HIGH ~25%; NR 228.2 vs RSS-4 278 → LOW ~18%; PA66 unfilled 216.37 vs CIF 266 before duty (≈286 landed) → LOW ~25%; PC 288.49 vs CIF 200 / domestic 211 → HIGH ~30%; PBT 309.1 vs 249 (index) → HIGH ~20% (moderate confidence: sources conflict); ABS 185.46 vs 165 → HIGH ~11% (moderate).

Suspect but not proven (listing-only evidence): E-glass woven fabric 451.7 and CSM 362.27 vs roving listings 50–150; E-coat 416.61 vs listing 185; Epoxy infusion system 1545 vs base LER 163–276 (formulation premium unknown).
GST: the Credco and plastic4trade pages do not state GST treatment in the extracts; IOCL lists are basic + GST. Polymer GST in India is 18% (not re-sourced here).
